points.name: Your choice

servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: From a deep interior clean to multi-stage paint correction, with high-quality products for every surface.

services.name: Full Detail
services.text: A complete interior and exterior detail in three packages: Touch N' Go, Traditional and Executive.

services.name: Interior Detail
services.text: Deep cleaning for carpets, seats, dashboard and more, with shampooing, leather care and disinfecting.

services.name: Exterior Detail
services.text: A thorough wash, decontamination, waxing and polishing to restore shine and protect the paint.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Long-lasting protection with extreme gloss and hydrophobic properties against UV, dirt and minor scratches.

services.name: Smoke & Malodor Removal
services.text: A shop-based package that neutralizes lingering smoke, pet and food odors with gas and enzyme treatments.

services.name: Water Intrusion & Mold Remediation
services.text: A shop-based service that removes seats, dries the subfloor and treats mold and mildew.

why.name: Convenience at your doorstep

why.name: Licensed and insured
why.text: A fully licensed and insured team.

why.name: Attention to detail
why.text: Every inch of your vehicle is cleaned, protected and restored.
